text.en:
Section 17 of Presidential Decree No. 87, as amended, is hereby further amended by adding a
second paragraph which section shall read as follows:
"Sec. 17. There is hereby created a Petroleum Board composed of the President of the Philippine National Oil
Company, as Chairman and the Secretary of National Defense, the Executive Secretary, the Secretary of
Natural Resources, the Secretary of Finance, the Secretary of Justice, the Secretary of Industry, the Governor
of the Central Bank and the Director of Mines as members. The Board shall designate and appoint its
Executive Director."
"The President of the Philippine National Oil Company shall relinguish the chairmanship of the board and
abstain from participating in the deliberations whenever matters involving the Philippine National Oils
Company directly or indirectly resulting in a conflict of interest are presented for consideration of the Board.
In such cases, a temporary presiding officer shall be elected from the members of the Board."

This Decree shall take effect upon its approval.
Done in the City of Manila, this 25th day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
